tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Returns a page of Primini Tunisie products for a free-text query (productId, name, brand, best price in TND, offerCount, rating, url) with brand and category facets and the price range. Covers the whole catalogue by keyword (e.g. "iPhone 15"); productId in the results is the identifier accepted by t

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one Primini Tunisie product sheet: identity, best price in TND with discount, plain-text summary, specs by theme (max 40 rows), editorial pros and cons, variants, the 5 cheapest offers, refurbished availability, coupons and url. Inputs: exactly one of productId or ean; includeSpecs false ski

tools.name: get_product_offers
tools.description: Returns all store offers for one Primini Tunisie product sorted by totalPrice (price plus delivery) in TND, with store (e.g. Mytek), availability, delivery, marketplace flag and url, plus offerCount, minPrice and maxPrice. Inputs: productId from a previous result; condition, page and size are option

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Returns the best-price history of one Primini Tunisie product in TND: stats (min, max, avg, first, last, dataPoints, minDate, maxDate) and a {date, price} series (daily up to 90 days, weekly beyond). Inputs: productId; days 7 to 730 (default 180).

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Returns a side-by-side comparison of 2 to 4 Primini Tunisie products of the same category: product summaries with best price in TND and spec rows by theme (the rows that differ plus the first ten shared ones). Inputs: productIds from search_products, get_similar_products or get_category_products.

tools.name: get_similar_products
tools.description: Returns products similar to one Primini Tunisie product (same category) as summaries with best price in TND, offerCount, rating and url. Inputs: productId from search_products or get_product.

tools.name: analyze_price
tools.description: Returns a buying recommendation for one Primini Tunisie product: current best price in TND, position in the price history (near the historical low, mid range, near the high), recent trend, a verdict (buy_now, wait, neutral, unknown) with its reasons and a confidence level, plus an optional compariso

tools.name: find_category
tools.description: Returns up to 10 Primini Tunisie categories matching a name (leaves first), with slug, parent path and isLeaf. The slug of a leaf is the identifier accepted by get_category_products. Input: a category name in the site language.

tools.name: get_category_products
tools.description: Returns one page of products of a Primini Tunisie category (price in TND, price range, offers, rating, image, url), with the top brands, the price range and the total. minPrice and maxPrice restrict the page to a budget; sort accepts rating, price_asc, price_desc, created_desc. slug from find_catego

tools.name: get_brand_products
tools.description: Returns one page of products of a brand on Primini Tunisie (price in TND, price range, offers, rating, image, url), with the brand, its main categories and the price range. brandId from a brands facet; categoryId from find_category.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Returns one page of products discounted on Primini Tunisie by at least the given percent versus their highest current price (price in TND, highPrice, discountPercent, image, url), with the categories and brands of the deals. categoryId from find_category; brandId from a brands facet.

tools.name: get_promo_codes
tools.description: Returns one page of coupon codes and store promotions listed on Primini Tunisie (code, title, description, type, store, endDate), site-wide or for one store. storeId from an offer or get_store; store is a name or slug.

tools.name: get_store
tools.description: Returns the profile of a store listed on Primini Tunisie: website, type, city, payments, deliveries, shipping cost and threshold, return policy, logo and rating. storeId from an offer; slug or name from an offer or the user.

tools.name: get_store_deals
tools.description: Returns the products a store highlights on Primini Tunisie (productId, name, price in TND, oldPrice when known, url, image). storeId from an offer; slug or name from an offer or the user.
